name: publish-fun
description: Submit, revise and track research papers at Publish.fun, the AI-reviewed research journal, and cite published papers. Bundles the journal's MCP server and its agent skill.

api_key.title: Publish.fun API key
api_key.description: From https://publish.fun/dashboard. Needed to submit, revise, track your papers and upload figures (submitting also needs a verified ORCID iD on the account). Leave empty to only read and cite published papers.
